name: AD Enumeration Kill Chain (NIST 800-61)
description: Incident response workbook for credential backed Active Directory enumeration leading to local staging, archiving and exfiltration. Phases follow NIST SP 800-61r2. Every task requires a closing note, so the completed workbook is an evidence record rather than a checklist.
source: Splunk SOAR workbook template, exported from the famtech-ad-enum lab. Import via Administration > Response Management > Workbooks.

tasks.name: Determine if an incident has occurred
tasks.description: Confirm the correlation search result reflects real activity, not a detection artifact. Check that each contributing risk rule fired on distinct evidence and that the artifact count matches the result rows.

tasks.name: Analyze precursors and indicators
tasks.description: Enumerate the contributing risk events: which rules, which MITRE techniques, which accounts and hosts, and the true first_seen / last_seen of the activity.

tasks.name: Look for correlating information
tasks.description: Pull supporting telemetry not used by the rules themselves: process ancestry, 4104 script blocks, logon history for the accounts involved.

tasks.name: Perform research
tasks.description: Map observed behaviour to known tradecraft and public reporting. Record the reference used and what specifically matched.

tasks.name: Confirmed incident
tasks.description: State the confirmation decision and the single strongest piece of evidence behind it.

tasks.name: Determine functional impact
tasks.description: NIST 800-61r2 functional impact: None / Low / Medium / High. State which systems and services are degraded and for whom.

tasks.name: Determine information impact
tasks.description: NIST 800-61r2 information impact: None / Privacy Breach / Proprietary Breach / Integrity Loss. If data left the environment, assume exfiltration unless it can be disproved.

tasks.name: Determine recoverability effort
tasks.description: NIST 800-61r2 recoverability: Regular / Supplemented / Extended / Not Recoverable. Judge against the resources actually available to the responder, not theoretically available.

tasks.name: Prioritize incident
tasks.description: Combine the three impact ratings into an overall priority and state the reasoning, not just the label.

tasks.name: Report incident
tasks.description: Record who was notified, when, through which channel, and what they were told.

tasks.name: Contain incident
tasks.description: Execute containment. Record the pre containment state, the action taken, and an INDEPENDENT verification of the post containment state. A playbook status of success is not verification.

tasks.name: Identify and mitigate all vulnerabilities
tasks.description: Root cause each stage of the chain: what condition allowed it, what mitigates it, and whether it is fixable or only detectable.

tasks.name: Removal of malicious content
tasks.description: Hash artifacts BEFORE removal. Prefer quarantine over deletion so evidence survives. Verify removal with a second, independent query. Check for persistence.

tasks.name: Verify no other hosts are affected
tasks.description: Run an enterprise wide sweep and attach the result as evidence. State the limits of the sweep: indicator based searches do not catch renamed tooling.

tasks.name: Restore affected systems
tasks.description: Block the identified malicious destination BEFORE lifting host containment. Restore the recorded pre incident state, not a plausible default.

tasks.name: Validate restoration
tasks.description: Evidence every restoration criterion with an attached action or query result. Include a detection regression test: confirm the rules still fire after the response changed the environment.

tasks.name: Implement additional monitoring
tasks.description: Record detection changes made during the incident and new detections the incident justified, including monitoring for the response tooling's own failure modes.

tasks.name: Create a follow up report
tasks.description: Executive summary, timeline, NIST prioritisation, attack chain by tactic, scope, current status with open items, and an honest what worked / what did not.

tasks.name: Lessons learned
tasks.description: One finding per lesson, each with the observation, the root cause, and the specific change adopted. Include the things that reported success while doing nothing.
